name: Fyxt
positioning: An AI operating system for commercial real estate operations, from lease abstraction to tenant billing.
description: Fyxt is a cloud platform for commercial real estate operations, combining AI-driven modules for portfolio information retrieval, task automation, multichannel communication, tenant experience, financial workflows (AP/AR), lease abstraction and insurance-certificate compliance. It targets commercial property managers, REITs, owner-operators and their tenants across office, industrial, retail, data-center and mixed commercial portfolios.
real_estate_use: A commercial property manager running a mixed portfolio of office and industrial buildings otherwise keeps lease terms, tenant insurance certificates and maintenance requests in separate systems that nobody fully trusts; Fyxt centralizes the lease abstraction, chases the missing certificate of insurance automatically, and lets a manager ask its AI chat for a portfolio answer instead of opening three spreadsheets to compile one.
features: AI chat access to centralized portfolio information
AI-assisted lease abstraction and insurance compliance tracking

use_cases.job: Track lease terms, tenant insurance compliance and maintenance across a mixed commercial portfolio from one system
Ask a portfolio question in natural language instead of compiling data from separate spreadsheets
